text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms first started?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, or a decrease in fetal movement? Have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any visual disturbances, right upper quadrant pain, or swelling in your hands and face? I would like to check for signs of pre-eclampsia given your gestational age.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. The patient is currently pregnant, at her 30th week of gestation. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. No recent travels or contact with sick individuals. No known allergies.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent consumption of ice cream and current symptoms, I suspect a foodborne illness. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, REQUEST TEST: Urine_Culture
